name: @agent-wiki-toolbox/quartz
description: The toolbox inside a Quartz build: folder notes served at the address the index gives them, prefixed cross-wiki links resolved from the target wiki's own content index, every page's heading anchors published, the shadow comparison of Quartz's link resolution against the toolbox's, images that open at full size, and a button back to the host's list of wikis

quartz.name: awt
quartz.description: Reads the toolbox's link-graph index (.awt-index.json) as data: moves a note beside a folder of its own name onto that folder's landing page, resolves prefix:path.md cross-wiki links, publishes static/awtHeadings.json, and fails the build when Quartz's link resolution disagrees with the toolbox's.
